runtime_console_negative.conclusion: The current runtime console exposes no direct effigy/petindex/upgrade_level/vanity_pet command or entity-name surface. This does not falsify the pet system because those identifiers can exist in data/UI/schema layers without console registration.

map_entity_definition.description: Location on the map where to place pet.
map_entity_definition.interpretation: cs_pet_placement is the strongest current map-level hook for locating an authored pet anchor. The egg model in the FGD is an editor visualization and is not by itself proof of a visible runtime egg.

server_schema.note: The class currently has no additional dumped fields, so position/class existence is the first useful runtime discriminator.

facts: XP-shop entries with flags bit 4 call InventoryAPI.GetPetItemID().
If a pet item already exists, the UI blocks the flagged bid path with localization key #chicken_egg_cannot_bid_own.
economy_pipeline.interpretation: A chicken-egg/pet acquisition path exists in the UI/economy layer independent of ordinary map chicken spawning.

econ_preview_schema.note: petindex is present in CEconItemPreviewDataBlock; adjacent upgrade_level is not yet proven pet-specific.

next_runtime_gate.goal: Test whether de_train contains an authored cs_pet_placement anchor.

outcomes.one_or_more_matches: PROMOTE: map-authored pet anchor exists. Record entindex, overlay position, Hammer ID if exposed, and exact world location.
outcomes.zero_matches: NEGATIVE: no runtime cs_pet_placement entity exposed on this Train session/build. This weakens the hypothesis that Henrietta is presently instantiated through the dedicated pet-placement class on de_train, but does not falsify menu/economy-only pet infrastructure.
